propositions: Cloud's AcliClient.update_issue must route empty-string or None assignee to unassign_issue rather than forwarding to ACLI as literal --assignee flag
When update_issue receives assignee='' or assignee=None with no other fields, it must call unassign_issue exactly once and spawn no workitem edit subprocess

When update_issue receives assignee='' or assignee=None alongside other editable fields like summary, it must call unassign_issue once and emit a workitem edit argv carrying the other fields but no --assignee flag
Non-empty assignee values must bypass unassign_issue and proceed through the normal validate-then-edit path with --assignee present in subprocess argv
The positive empty-assignee behavior must be explicitly tested to prevent regression from silent re-forwarding of empty strings to ACLI
